## Decision: attached semantic context
An attached campaign/workspace view must resolve activity subjects into human-meaningful work semantics. It joins each job/attempt/unit identity to a versioned semantic snapshot identified by campaign/run, workspace or campaign commit, and contract digest.

The response exposes unit label and phase, array index or packed member, declared resource request, dependency position, command or analysis label, expected output/validation contract, and source provenance. It distinguishes semantics at the time of an event from the currently checked-out campaign definition; a changed definition is visible as a changed commit/digest, never silently rewritten into old history.

When no matching attached workspace or exact snapshot is available, readers show raw identity plus `semantic_context: unavailable|stale`; they do not infer semantics from job names. Semantic context aids presentation and diagnosis only. The remote ledger, scheduler evidence, validation receipt, and campaign records remain authoritative.

Acceptance amendment: attached CLI and MCP readers must return this context with its version/freshness; tests cover array and packed unit resolution, historical-versus-current definition changes, and unavailable/stale context.
